name: QP Kiss
source: QP Kiss is a short parody Boys' Love visual novel with shoot'em up elements, released by the developers of the Orange Juice franchise as an April Fools' prank in 2007. The characters are genderbent versions of characters from other Orange Juice games. The plot revolves around Kyupita, a dog-eared boy, and his perverted lover Kyousuke, who had gone mad. Description paraphrased from https://100orangejuice.gamepedia.com/QP_Kiss
translation: QP Kiss是一部带有射击元素的模仿《Boys' Love》视觉小说的短篇小说，由《橙汁》系列的开发商于2007年作为愚人节恶作剧而发行。其中的角色是其他《橙汁》游戏中角色的性别扭曲版本。故事围绕着卷角少年久皮塔和他发疯的变态恋人恭介展开。描述转述自https://100orangejuice.gamepedia.com/QP_Kiss
